source.title: Northern Whig, 4 May 1939, p. 10 ("Fermanagh County Council": rural districts, Lisnaskea)
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Read on the page image (BNA IIIF crop): the Lisnaskea list prints 'Lisnaskea—W. Hall, Tullynevin; Magheraveely—John W. M'Vitty, ...; Maguiresbridge—Henry Boles'. 'J. M'Vitty' votes with the Unionists at the council's annual meeting (Irish News, 6 June 1939, p. 5).

note: Triennial rural district council election, end of May 1939; there was no contest in the Lisnaskea district (Northern Whig, 4 May 1939, p. 10). Returned unopposed. The OCR of this list drops the word 'Magheraveely', which is why the Lisnaskea division for 1939 had carried both W. Hall and W. M'Vitty until it was corrected on 12 November 2026.
